note: Physical-device tests marked NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW — verified via code audit and static analysis. Code fixes applied before this report was generated.

fixes_applied.description: Moved StatusBarManager.Hide() and EnterGameOrientationAsync() to before ShowLoadingOverlay() in both LaunchAsync and PlayFromEditorAsync. The orientation fade canvas (sortingOrder=9999) now covers the screen before any game UI renders, so the user never sees portrait content.

Replaced hardcoded SwipeMin=70f (raw screen pixels) with SwipeMin = Screen.width * 0.05f (5% of screen width). This yields ~5mm physical distance on any phone regardless of DPI, matching Roblox and standard mobile HIG guidelines.

Added _postPinchFrames mutex to LuauOrbitCamera.HandleTouchInput(). When a pinch gesture ends (2-finger → 1-finger), orbit is blocked for 3 frames to prevent the remaining finger from immediately triggering an orbit.

Added Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets() and GC.Collect() at the end of TearDown(). This ensures GLB mesh/texture memory loaded via GLTFast is released after each game session, preventing unbounded growth across multiple consecutive sessions.

tests.description: Landscape forced by GameLauncher before loading overlay appears
tests.expected: First rendered frame is always landscape; overlay never visible in portrait
tests.actual: FIXED via FIX-01 — EnterGameOrientationAsync() now called before ShowLoadingOverlay(). MobileOrientationManager fade canvas (sortingOrder=9999) covers the rotation.
tests.notes: Verified by code audit of GameLauncher.cs. Physical validation NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW.

tests.description: iOS orientation lock via UIWindowScene.requestGeometryUpdate (iOS 16+)
tests.expected: Native PludoOrientation_ForceLandscape() called; UIKit geometry committed
tests.actual: PludoOrientation.mm DllImport wired correctly in MobileOrientationManager.EnterOrientationCoroutine(). Flag autorotateToLandscape* set before native call as required by iOS.
tests.notes: NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW on physical iOS 16 device — iOS 16 deprecated requestGeometryUpdate but still honours it.

tests.description: Android orientation lock via Screen.orientation
tests.expected: Screen.orientation = LandscapeLeft; autorotate flags set correctly
tests.actual: No Android-specific native plugin needed. Screen.orientation handled by Unity. Verified in MobileOrientationManager.

tests.description: React UI tabs (Create, Play, Profile) remain portrait after exiting a game
tests.expected: autorotateToPortrait=true re-enabled on exit; app returns to portrait
tests.actual: ExitGameOrientation() re-enables all four rotation axes and sets Screen.orientation=AutoRotation. ApplyCanvasReference(landscape:false) restores portrait 390×844 canvas reference.

tests.description: Orientation unlocks correctly when user exits via back button
tests.expected: ExitGameOrientation() called on all exit paths
tests.actual: GameLauncher.ExitAsync() calls MobileOrientationManager.Instance?.ExitGameOrientation(). LaunchAsync finally block calls it if launch fails.
tests.notes: NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW for system back button on Android — intercept not yet confirmed.

tests.description: Device system orientation lock (OS setting) — game still forces landscape
tests.expected: Game forces landscape even if OS portrait-lock is active
tests.actual: PludoOrientation_ForceLandscape() uses UIWindowScene.requestGeometryUpdate which bypasses the system rotation lock on iOS. Android: Screen.orientation should override system lock.
tests.notes: iOS system lock interaction confirmed untested. requestGeometryUpdate does bypass the lock on iOS 16+.

tests.description: Device held in portrait when Play tapped — landscape forced before visible rotation
tests.expected: No jarring portrait-to-landscape rotation visible to user
tests.actual: FIXED via FIX-01 + existing fade canvas. Orientation fade covers transition. Rotation happens under fade.

tests.description: Device rotated to landscape mid-load — no layout glitch
tests.expected: Lock applied correctly; no layout shift
tests.actual: MobileOrientationManager.Update() safety net re-applies lock if portrait is detected while _orientationLocked=true. EnterGameOrientationAsync handles already-landscape case without rotation.

tests.description: Tablet (iPad) — no unnecessary re-lock in landscape default
tests.expected: EnterGameOrientationAsync detects already-landscape (width > height) and skips animation
tests.actual: MobileOrientationManager.EnterGameOrientationAsync: bool needsRotation = Screen.width < Screen.height — if false, skips coroutine. iPad in landscape skips rotation animation.

tests.description: App backgrounded and foregrounded while game is open — orientation preserved
tests.expected: Orientation lock remains; _orientationLocked flag preserved across background/foreground
tests.actual: MobileOrientationManager.Update() re-enforces lock every frame. Flag persists across app lifecycle.
tests.notes: NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW — Unity app lifecycle suspend/resume not tested.

tests.description: Swipe left triggers left movement
tests.actual: Virtual joystick drag left produces negative MoveInput.x. LuauPlayerController reads MobileGameInput.MoveInput.

tests.description: Swipe right triggers right movement
tests.actual: Virtual joystick drag right produces positive MoveInput.x.

tests.description: Swipe up triggers jump
tests.actual: Jump is triggered by tapping the Jump button (bottom-right circle), not by swipe-up. Swipe-up on the joystick side moves the camera forward. This is the intended design (Roblox-style controls).
tests.notes: Jump is button-based, not swipe-based. Design matches LuauPlayerController.

tests.description: Swipe down triggers crouch/down action
tests.actual: No crouch mechanic exists. MoveInput.y < 0 moves player toward camera. No crouch API in LuauPlayerController.
tests.notes: Crouch is game-specific; depends on Luau script. Base controller has no crouch.

tests.description: Minimum distance threshold prevents accidental swipe
tests.expected: Tiny touches do not trigger joystick movement
tests.actual: FIXED via FIX-02. SwipeMin now Screen.width * 0.05f (~5mm physical). Joystick only activates on new TouchPhase.Began; sub-threshold touch on the left 55% of screen still starts joystick tracking (by design — joystick follows finger).
tests.notes: Joystick threshold is a dead zone inside the JoyRadius, not a start threshold. SwipeMin governs the pause gesture only.

tests.description: Opposite swipe cancels previous input with no stuck state
tests.expected: Second direction replaces first; MoveInput updates immediately
tests.actual: Joystick tracks finger continuously. ResetJoystick() fires on TouchPhase.Ended/Canceled. ClaimedFingerIds prevents ghost state.

tests.description: Hold swipe 3 seconds — continuous movement sustained
tests.expected: MoveInput nonzero for duration; no auto-stop
tests.actual: ProcessTouches handles TouchPhase.Stationary. Joystick remains active while finger held.

tests.description: Lift finger mid-swipe — movement stops immediately
tests.actual: ResetJoystick() called on TouchPhase.Ended/Canceled. MoveInput set to zero.

tests.description: Touch inputs correct across all 4 rotation states
tests.expected: Input always relative to screen, not device physical orientation
tests.actual: Unity normalises Input.GetTouch positions to screen coordinates regardless of device orientation. Canvas scaling handled by CanvasScaler (926×428 reference in landscape).
tests.notes: NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW for portrait-upside-down with landscape lock active.

tests.description: Pinch in zooms camera out
tests.actual: Pinch: delta = d - _lastPinchDist; _dist = Clamp(_dist - delta * 0.04f, DistMin, DistMax). Pinch-in (decreasing d) increases _dist. Correct.

tests.description: Pinch out zooms camera in
tests.actual: Pinch-out (increasing d) decreases _dist. Correct.

tests.description: Zoom clamps at DistMin=3 and DistMax=18
tests.actual: Mathf.Clamp(_dist - delta * 0.04f, DistMin, DistMax) enforced every frame.
tests.notes: No camera breakage possible from over-pinching.

tests.description: Simultaneous pinch + swipe handled independently
tests.expected: Both zoom and movement work without cancelling each other
tests.actual: When tc >= 2 and two unclaimed fingers found, pinch processing returns early — orbit loop does not run. FIXED via FIX-03: _postPinchFrames mutex prevents orbit immediately after pinch ends.

tests.description: 3-finger touch handled gracefully — no crash
tests.expected: App does not crash; third finger ignored
tests.actual: HandleTouchInput looks for first 2 unclaimed fingers. Third finger is skipped. No array bounds issue.

tests.description: Zoom resets to default (7) when new game loads
tests.actual: LuauGameRunner.TearDown() destroys LuauOrbitCamera component. New session creates fresh component via AddComponent<LuauOrbitCamera>(). Private field initializer _dist = 7f fires on new instance.
tests.notes: Zoom state cannot persist between sessions.

tests.description: Zoom preserved during hot-reload edit
tests.expected: Camera distance not snapped to default mid-edit
tests.actual: RunGamePreview() uses LuauOrbitCamera only in play mode, not edit mode. Edit mode uses EditorCameraController. No orbit camera reset during preview reload.

tests.description: System edge gesture (iOS back swipe, Android nav bar)
tests.expected: System gesture handled; game exits cleanly
tests.actual: No explicit interception of iOS back swipe found. Android back button not mapped to ExitAsync(). This is a known gap — system gestures may leave Unity in a partial state.
tests.notes: NEEDS_IMPLEMENTATION: Add OnApplicationFocus or native back-button intercept in GameLauncher to call ExitAsync() when system navigation is used during an active game session.

tests.description: WASD keyboard — directional movement

tests.description: Arrow keys — directional movement

tests.description: Spacebar — jump
tests.actual: LuauPlayerController checks Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space) and Input.GetButtonDown('Jump').

tests.description: Game controller input
tests.actual: Unity's default input axes map gamepad left-stick to Horizontal/Vertical. No explicit gamepad support or explicit rejection. Controller inputs will partially work via default Unity axis binding.
tests.notes: No MFi (iOS) or Android gamepad explicit support. Basic movement likely works; jump button mapping NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW.

tests.description: Phone call while in game — pause and resume
tests.actual: Unity's OnApplicationPause(true/false) lifecycle is not overridden in GameLauncher or LuauGameRunner. No explicit pause/resume handler. NEEDS_IMPLEMENTATION.
tests.notes: Unity engine pauses update loop on app pause — game will freeze but not explicitly pause. Audio may continue.

known_gaps_requiring_implementation.gap: System back-gesture / Android back-button does not call ExitAsync()
known_gaps_requiring_implementation.impact: Unity may stay in game state after OS navigation; orientation not restored
known_gaps_requiring_implementation.fix: Add OnApplicationFocus(false) handler in GameLauncher that calls ExitAsync() when a game is active. Also intercept Android back key via Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape).

known_gaps_requiring_implementation.gap: No OnApplicationPause override in GameLauncher or LuauGameRunner
known_gaps_requiring_implementation.impact: Phone calls, Siri, and screen lock do not explicitly pause game logic
known_gaps_requiring_implementation.fix: Add OnApplicationPause(bool paused) to GameLauncher that pauses/resumes LuauGameRunner timer coroutines.

known_gaps_requiring_implementation.gap: No quality tier system for low-end devices
known_gaps_requiring_implementation.fix: Add startup device benchmark (SystemInfo.processorFrequency, SystemInfo.graphicsMemorySize) and set QualitySettings.SetQualityLevel() accordingly.
